liebermann.notes: Manuscript once at Saint-Évroult, used by Ordericus Vitalis, mainly saints' lives largely of Anglo-Saxon origin, considered English; f. 109–16 Iudicium Dei X, printed by Martène and Zeumer, whose text Liebermann follows.
